Bash(CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="" wrangler d1 execute bgapp-data --remote --command="
SELECT 
  name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master t WHERE t.name = m.name) as table_exists,
  CASE 
    WHEN name = ''vessel_data'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vessel_data)
    WHEN name = ''vessel_presence'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vessel_presence)
    WHEN name = ''fishing_events'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fishing_events)
    WHEN name = ''marine_data'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marine_data)
    WHEN name = ''sst_data'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sst_data)
    WHEN name = ''ocean_color_data'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocean_color_data)
    WHEN name = ''salinity_data'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salinity_data)
    WHEN name = ''vessel_lights_data'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vessel_lights_data)
    WHEN name = ''eez_boundaries'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eez_boundaries)
    WHEN name = ''ml_predictions'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ml_predictions)
    WHEN name = ''gis_points'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gis_points)
    WHEN name = ''fishing_infrastructure'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fishing_infrastructure)
    WHEN name = ''biodiversity_observations'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biodiversity_observations)
    WHEN name = ''environmental_alerts'' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM environmental_alerts)
    ELSE 0
  END as row_count
FROM (
  SELECT ''vessel_data'' as name
  UNION SELECT ''vessel_presence''
  UNION SELECT ''fishing_events''
  UNION SELECT ''marine_data''
  UNION SELECT ''sst_data''
  UNION SELECT ''ocean_color_data''
  UNION SELECT ''salinity_data''
  UNION SELECT ''vessel_lights_data''
  UNION SELECT ''eez_boundaries''
  UNION SELECT ''ml_predictions''
  UNION SELECT ''gis_points''
  UNION SELECT ''fishing_infrastructure''
  UNION SELECT ''biodiversity_observations''
  UNION SELECT ''environmental_alerts''
) m;")
